components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header link: mono uppercase, lime underline draws in on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c2c9b4; text-decoration: none; padding-block: 0.35rem; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 1px; background: #c8f542; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #eef1e6; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #c8f542; }

components.name: Stack Tag
components.description: Tech-stack chip: raised surface, hairline border, mono uppercase, lime on hover.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; border: 1px solid rgba(238, 241, 230, 0.14); border-radius: 999px; color: #c2c9b4; background: #0f120c; transition: border-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease; } .ds-tag:hover { border-color: #c8f542; color: #c8f542; background: rgba(200, 245, 66, 0.12); }

components.name: Project Link
components.description: Inline action link: Space Grotesk 600, lime underline draw, arrow nudge on hover.
components.css: .ds-project-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #eef1e6; text-decoration: none; position: relative; padding-bottom: 0.2rem; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-project-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; height: 1.5px; background: #c8f542; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-project-link:hover { color: #c8f542; } .ds-project-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-project-link:hover .ds-project-link-arrow { transform: translate(3px, -3px); } .ds-project-link-arrow { transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); }

components.name: Contact Row
components.description: Contact row: hairline-separated, mono label + display value, lime border and slide on hover.
components.css: .ds-contact-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding-block: 1.35rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(238, 241, 230, 0.07); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-contact-label { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8d957c; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-contact-value { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 3vw, 1.55rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #eef1e6; transition: color 0.3s ease, transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-contact-row:hover { border-top-color: #c8f542; } .ds-contact-row:hover .ds-contact-label { color: #c8f542; } .ds-contact-row:hover .ds-contact-value { color: #c8f542; transform: translateX(0.35rem); }

narrative.overview: The site presents a developer's shipped work the way a well-built instrument panel presents a machine: a near-black field, one electric-lime filament of light, hairline rules, and data set in mono. Nothing shouts; everything is legible at a glance. The world is quiet and precise — a Nairobi developer's work shown under a single lime lamp, with whitespace and restraint doing the work that decoration usually does. The system is deliberately anti-template: no hero-screenshot-plus-card-grid, no gradient text, no glass for decoration. Projects are described in paragraphs rather than thumbnailed into sameness, and motion is orchestrated as one authored system rather than scattered hover effects.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black green-tinted grounds with one electric-lime accent used as a system, not decoration
Hairline rules and mono data labels (indices, tags, coordinates) throughout
Space Grotesk display over Instrument Sans body; Space Mono reserved for data
Scroll-driven motion: Lenis smooth scroll, GSAP ScrollTrigger reveals and parallax, one light Three.js accent
Restraint is the brand: generous whitespace, more space above headings than below

rules.name: The One Filament Rule
rules.body: Electric lime is reserved for interactive and orienting moments; it never fills backgrounds or borders at rest. If lime is used on more than ~5% of a resting screen, it's decoration.

rules.name: The Data-Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono never decorates. It appears only where the content is data: index numerals, stack tags, coordinates, meta labels. Body copy is never set in mono.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows appear only on elements that earn elevation (image frames). No hard offset shadows, no glow-as-decoration.

dos: Do use electric lime only for interaction and orientation — nav active, links, indices, nodes, tags on hover.
Do set data (indices, tags, coordinates, meta) in Space Mono.
Do keep paragraphs at or under 62ch and set body in Instrument Sans.
Do give more vertical space above headings than below.
Do use hairline rules and tonal layering for separation before reaching for shadows.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: everything is visible and static without JS or motion.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glass blur as decoration, or hard offset shadows.
Don't add eyebrows/kickers above headings — headings carry their own weight.
Don't set body copy in mono or decorate with emoji/Unicode glyphs.
Don't ship project rows as equal image+title cards — every project carries a real description.
Don't hard-code colors; the palette lives in src/styles/tokens.css and the DESIGN.md frontmatter.
